new_value: Migrated rust/lichen-core to upstream Yggdrasil addressing (commit 5c9f7ef657). ygg_addr_from_pubkey now implements upstream AddrForKey byte-for-byte (bit-invert key; addr[0]=0x02; addr[1]=leading-1 count as u8 with Go byte-overflow wrap at 256; skip leading 1s + separator 0 bit; pack remaining bits MSB-first into whole bytes, discard trailing partial; addr[2:16] zero tail; no hashing — yggdrasil-go@422836ee src/address/address.go, which I fetched and ported literally). Added subnet_for_key (addr[0..8], byte0|=0x01 -> 0300::/8). iid_from_pubkey_bytes body UNCHANGED (SHA-512 IID, link-local only); docstring updated. TESTS: rewrote yggdrasil_addr_vectors.rs (anchor -> byte-equality, added subnet byte-equality + degenerate all-zero-key + no-IID-embedding); cleaned ipv6_address_vectors.rs (dropped rejected native/IID-binding pins, kept IID+link-local+negative). Swept dead IID-binding invariant: fixed capability_announcements.rs pubkey_to_iid (was addr[8..]) and trust.rs/resources.rs native-addr test vectors (regenerated via independent oracle).
